teaser.en: Its two-tone flowers hang like little Chinese lanterns, pink above and yellow below.
teaser.sw: Maua yake ya rangi mbili huning'inia kama taa ndogo za karatasi za Kichina, waridi juu na manjano chini.

summary.en: *Mchinjiri* is the sicklebush, a thorny shrub of bush and fallow land with striking two-coloured flower spikes. It is a popular Digo medicine, and its roots are boiled for malaria.
summary.sw: *Mchinjiri* ni kichaka chenye miiba cha vichakani na mashamba yaliyoachwa, chenye mashada ya maua ya rangi mbili yanayovutia. Ni dawa maarufu ya Kidigo, na mizizi yake huchemshwa kwa ajili ya malaria.

about.en: *Mchinjiri* is a thorny shrub with feathery leaves made of many tiny leaflets. Its flowers are unmistakable: hanging spikes that are pink or mauve at the top and yellow below, like small lanterns, which gives it the English name Chinese lantern tree. After flowering it bears clusters of tightly twisted pods.
about.sw: *Mchinjiri* ni kichaka chenye miiba na majani kama manyoya yaliyoundwa kwa vijani vingi vidogo sana. Maua yake hayawezi kukosewa: mashada yanayoning'inia, ya waridi au zambarau hafifu juu na manjano chini, kama taa ndogo, jambo linaloupa jina la Kiingereza *Chinese lantern tree*. Baada ya kuchanua huzaa vishada vya maganda yaliyojisokota kwa nguvu.

where.en: It grows in bushland, wooded grassland and fallow fields, often springing up thickly where land has been cleared and left. Look for the lantern flowers along paths and field edges.
where.sw: Huota vichakani, katika nyika zenye miti na mashamba yaliyoachwa, mara nyingi ukichipuka kwa wingi mahali ambapo ardhi imefyekwa na kuachwa. Tafuta maua yake kama taa kando ya njia na pembezoni mwa mashamba.

uses.en: It is a popular medicine. The Digo of Diani boil the roots to treat malaria.
uses.sw: Ni dawa maarufu. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi kutibu malaria.

culture.en: Its second Digo name, *mpingwa*, comes from *pinga*, 'oppose': the plant is said to oppose the effects of disease.
culture.sw: Jina lake la pili la Kidigo, *mpingwa*, linatokana na *pinga*, 'kupinga': mmea huu husemekana kupinga madhara ya magonjwa.

names.en: In Digo it is *mchinjiri* or *mpingwa*. *Mchinjiri* is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. The Mgombato dictionary gives Swahili alternatives *mkulajembe* and *mvunjajembe msingino*. In English it is sicklebush or Chinese lantern tree.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo ni *mchinjiri* au *mpingwa*. *Mchinjiri* linatumika pia katika Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa majina mbadala ya Kiswahili *mkulajembe* na *mvunjajembe msingino*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *sicklebush* au *Chinese lantern tree*.

reason.sw: *Chikwata kombe* (*hook-thorn*), kichaka kingine chenye miiba cha jamii ya kunde

reason.en: Violet tree, whose roots are also boiled for malaria
reason.sw: *Mziji* (*violet tree*), ambao mizizi yake pia huchemshwa kwa ajili ya malaria

reason.en: Spiny shrub also used for malaria
reason.sw: Kichaka chenye miiba ambacho pia hutumika kwa malaria
*Albizia*, mmea jamaa wa vichakani wa jamii ya kunde

mgombato: mchinjiri (mi) type of plant: sickle bush (Dichrostachys cinerea); mkulajembe, mvunjajembe msingino.
